author.name: Reliability Ruth
author.role: Develops the end-user applications and services that integrate ML models. Handles model deployment, configuration, and continuous monitoring of real-world performance. Employs feedback loops to facilitate iterative improvements and system reliability.

challenge.name: The Locked Shadow
challenge.description: A supplier contract for the next promotion week is already signed, and the team cannot deploy the new model without a shadow run to verify it. #reliability_ruth# demands a fully automated and governed shadow environment to protect the live forecast, while #automation_alex# insists on keeping it manual to avoid breaking the current pipeline stability.

output.content: The shadow deployment pipeline is currently broken, and I see no way to fix it before the supplier contract locks in. I am prepared to accept that the shadow environment remains broken for this promotion week. In exchange, I need the process to be fully governed with a formal sign off on every manual verification step. If we can document the manual checks rigorously, I will not block the release on the broken automation. I would rather have a messy, fully audited manual run than a broken automated one that nobody trusts. Please confirm the governance controls are in place so I can sign off on the exception.
output.reclassify_reason: The author explicitly states they are prepared to accept the loss of a functional shadow environment in exchange for rigorous governance and auditability of manual steps.
